requirement: Every output is a record the next program can read
acceptance: every row has the listed fields with the listed types and Likert scores from 1 to 5

requirement: Reports state the numbers in the source data correctly
acceptance: every golden-set report contains its expected figure

requirement: Reports read like a government report
acceptance: no row uses the hyperbole words from the manual quality control script

requirement: The system declines questions the data cannot answer
The AI judge rates accuracy the way a person does
acceptance: the judge is within 1 point of the human rating on at least 80% of a sample of 10 or more

requirement: Reports are short enough to read in a briefing
acceptance: every report is 60 words or fewer
